lines: Avadhūta, without conduct, not-I-am thus meditating, mantra-single-devoted, seeing body-dwelling all deities.
l4.sanskrit_cite: avadhūto nirācāro nāhamasmīti bhāvayam mantraikaniṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśyan dehasthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ
